descriptionModule.briefSummary: Ticagrelor is a new, reversible binding, anti-platelet medication. Anti-platelet medications work to prevent the formation of blood clots. Ticagrelor is being developed as a treatment for patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS). ACS is a term that is used to describe both heart attacks in progress or the imminent threat of a heart attack. ACS is usually caused by the formation of a blood clot in an artery that partially or totally blocks the blood supply to a portion of the heart muscle. Ticagrelor will be compared with clopidogrel to determine which drug, when either is used in conjunction with aspirin, is better at reducing deaths from vascular causes, future heart attacks and/or strokes in patients with ACS.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female 18 years or older who has been hospitalised for chest pain and potential ACS
* Females of child-bearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test at enrollment and be willing to use 2 methods of reliable contraception

Exclusion Criteria:

* Persons with moderate or severe liver disease
* Persons who have already been treated with an invasive (angioplasty) procedure for the current episode of ACS
* Persons who are being treated with blood clotting agents that cannot be stopped

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Comparison of Ticagrelor (AZD6140) and Clopidogrel in Patients With Acute Coronary Syndrome
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomised, Double-blind, Parallel Group, Phase 3, Efficacy and Safety Study of Ticagrelor Compared With Clopidogrel for Prevention of Vascular Events in Patients With Non-ST or ST Elevation Acute Coronary Syndromes (ACS) [PLATO- a Study of PLATelet Inhibition and Patient Outcomes]

primaryOutcomes.description: Participants with death from vascular causes, MI, or stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. Intention To Treat (ITT) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
primaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Death From Vascular Causes, Myocardial Infarction (MI), and Stroke

primaryOutcomes.description: Participants with major (fatal/life-threatening or other) bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
primaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Any Major Bleeding Event

secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants with death from vascular causes, MI, or stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT analysis of intent for invasive management population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Death From Vascular Causes, MI, and Stroke for the Subgroup of Patients With Intent for Invasive Management at Randomization

secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants with death from any cause, MI, or stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal of consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of All-cause Mortality, MI, and Stroke

secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants with death from vascular causes, MI, stroke, recurrent ischemia, or other thrombotic events. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Death From Vascular Causes, MI (Including Silent), Stroke, Recurrent Ischemia, Transient Ischemic Attack (TIA) and Other Arterial Thrombotic Events.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants with MI event. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT (intention to treat) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.

Participants with death from vascular causes. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT (intention to treat) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Death From Any Cause

secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants with non CABG related major (fatal/life-threatening or other) bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Non-CABG (Coronary Artery Bypass Graft) Related Major Bleeding

secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants with major (fatal/life-threatening or other) or minor bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Major or Minor Bleeding

secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants with non-procedural major bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.

Participants with a major CABG-related bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. All CABG surgeries were submitted for adjudication by an endpoint committee as potential bleeds.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Major Bleeding

secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with a major fatal/life-threatening CABG-related bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. All CABG surgeries were submitted for adjudication by an endpoint committee as potential bleeds.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants With Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Major Fatal/Life-threatening Bleeding

secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants who were observed to have at least 1 ventricular pause of at least 3 seconds. Population is all patients who were observed over 2 week-long periods. Pauses were flagged algorithmically and confirmed by Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction (TIMI) group cardiologists.

certainAgreement.otherDetails: An Investigator agrees to provide a copy of the publication to AstraZeneca (AZ) for review at least 60 days in advance of submission for publication. Investigators in multicenter (MC) studies agree to postpone MC publications until the earlier of the date of the first AZ-authorized MC publication or a period up to 18 months from study completion at all sites.

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with death from vascular causes, MI, or stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. Intention To Treat (ITT) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Death From Vascular Causes, Myocardial Infarction (MI), and Stroke

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with major (fatal/life-threatening or other) bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the safety analysis set, which included all randomized patients who took at least one dose of study drug
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Any Major Bleeding Event

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with death from vascular causes, MI, or stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT analysis of intent for invasive management population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The subgroup of patients with intent for invasive management at randomization
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Death From Vascular Causes, MI, and Stroke for the Subgroup of Patients With Intent for Invasive Management at Randomization

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with death from any cause, MI, or stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal of consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of All-cause Mortality, MI, and Stroke

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with death from vascular causes, MI, stroke, recurrent ischemia, or other thrombotic events. outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Any Event From the Composite of Death From Vascular Causes, MI (Including Silent), Stroke, Recurrent Ischemia, Transient Ischemic Attack (TIA) and Other Arterial Thrombotic Events.

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with MI event. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT (intention to treat) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With MI Event

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with death from vascular causes. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT (intention to treat) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Death From Vascular Causes

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with stroke. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT (intention to treat) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Stroke

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with death from any cause. If no event, censoring occurs at the earliest of patient withdrawal consent or date of scheduled withdrawal from therapy. ITT (intention to treat) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Death From Any Cause

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with non CABG related major (fatal/life-threatening or other) bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the safety analysis set, which included all randomized patients who took at least one dose of study drug
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Non-CABG (Coronary Artery Bypass Graft) Related Major Bleeding

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with major (fatal/life-threatening or other) or minor bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the safety analysis set, which included all randomized patients who took at least one dose of study drug
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Major or Minor Bleeding

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with non-procedural major bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The population was the safety analysis set, which included all randomized patients who took at least one dose of study drug
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Non-procedural Major Bleeding

outcomeMeasures.description: Participants with a major CABG-related bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. All CABG surgeries were submitted for adjudication by an endpoint committee as potential bleeds.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Population is all patients who underwent CABG surgery within 7 days of last dose of active study medication.
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Major Bleeding

outcomeMeasures.description: Number of participants with a major fatal/life-threatening CABG-related bleed by a study protocol scale based on need for treatment, number of transfusions, hemoglobin decrease, and other factors. All CABG surgeries were submitted for adjudication by an endpoint committee as potential bleeds.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Population is all patients who underwent CABG surgery within 7 days of last dose of active study medication.
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Major Fatal/Life-threatening Bleeding

outcomeMeasures.description: Number of participants who were observed to have at least 1 ventricular pause of at least 3 seconds. Population is all patients who were observed over 2 week-long periods. Pauses were flagged algorithmically and confirmed by Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction (TIMI) group cardiologists.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Participants with Holter data in the week after Randomization
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Ventricular Pauses of Greater Than or Equal to 3 Seconds in Patients Monitored by Holter 24-hour ECG Recorders for 1 Week Following Randomization

outcomeMeasures.description: Number of participants who were observed to have at least 1 ventricular pause of at least 3 seconds. Population is all patients who were observed over 2 week-long periods. Pauses were flagged algorithmically and confirmed by TIMI cardiologists.
outcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Patients who were monitored for one week following randomization (and for one week one month later).
outcomeMeasures.title: Participants With Ventricular Pauses of Greater Than or Equal to 3 Seconds in Patients Monitored by Holter 24 Hour ECG Recorders for 1 Week at 1 Month Following Randomization

participantFlowModule.preAssignmentDetails: Participants will already be hospitalized due to their acute condition, and must be enrolled and randomized within 24 hours of the onset of their most recent cardiac ischemic symptoms. Randomization should take place as soon as possible after presentation.
participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: The first participant was enrolled on 11 October 2006 and the last participant completed the study on 27 February 2009. Study participants were randomized from 855 centers in 43 countries.
